nodes.label: Carriers update downstream first
nodes.rationale: So a line carries its rated speed regardless of build order.

nodes.label: Central storage (global pool, 100% refund)
nodes.rationale: No capacity limit; the user decided to leave it that way, so no Hub capacity upgrade.

nodes.label: Coins and auto-sell (with reserve)
nodes.rationale: Reserve of 50 per item so selling can't use up building material.

nodes.label: Fixed 20 ticks/s simulation
nodes.rationale: Runs whenever the app is open (even hidden); no offline progress.

nodes.label: Fluid networks (pump, pipe, refinery)
nodes.rationale: One fluid type per network, no pressure physics; pumps work anywhere like a well.

nodes.label: Global Hotkey Poller (GetAsyncKeyState / XQueryKeymap)
nodes.rationale: InputLib has no license, so its approach is reimplemented and none of its code copied; background thread polls one combo about every 30 ms.

nodes.label: Potions (non-stacking strengths)
nodes.rationale: Strengths never stack: strongest runs first, weaker wait.

nodes.label: Power as a bonus (networks, generators, poles)
nodes.norm_label: power as a bonus (networks, generators, poles)
nodes.rationale: Decided with the user: power is a bonus, not a requirement; unpowered runs normal speed, full power doubles it.
